glosses: to act, to feign (to create a false impression)
to pretend to be (to intentionally act like a person whom one is not)
to share (to give a portion of)
to get rid of, to do away with
to work out, to succeed (to finish as intended or expected)

examples.text: I udało się, że jeden żyd bardzo bogaty.
examples.translation: And it turned out, that one Jew was very rich.
examples.english: And it turned out, that one Jew was very rich.

glosses: to repair, to head off, to go (to go to a particular place)
to fruit (to have a large output; to mature well)
to turn out alright (to grow into a person who gains acceptance from those around him)
to come in handy (to be useful)

examples.text: Operacja się udała, ale pacjent zmarł – zażartował lekarz, ale gdy spojrzał na Brodziaka, uśmiech natychmiast zniknął z jego twarzy

glosses: Prendre la pose, jouer un rôle.
